### 🎁 Expected Outcome by the EU

::: {.callout-important icon=true}
### Expected Outcomes: {{< meta title >}} 
- 🦾 **Transform industrial jobs** via AI-based human-machine interactions that enhance "flexibility, inclusion, well-being, up-skilling, career evolution and knowledge sharing".
- 📈 **Boost manufacturing competitiveness** and sustainability by means of "knowledge formalization" and the "adaptability of the machines to workers and markets based on different cultures".
:::

### 🏗️ Scope Summary

::: {.callout-warning icon=true}
### Scope: {{< meta title >}} 

The proposals must produce dedicated innovative AI approaches for human-machine collaboration in advanced manufacturing, applied in at least two of the following fields:

- 🎓 **Human-AI Co-Learning:** Capturing expert knowledge and formalizing "dispersed and not explicit" know-how to reduce onboarding times, support personnel upskilling, and avoid "loss of know-how" at the factory level.
- 🤝 **Human-AI Teamwork:** Introducing "innovative natural interaction models" (including hardware interfaces or collaborative machine tools) to control complexity in cognitive production systems and shop-floor planning.
- 🌍 **Adaptive Automation Interfaces:** Engineering automation systems that automatically adapt to "particular needs of the human", accommodating different worker abilities and "different cultural needs" to simplify export dynamics.

⚖️ **Inclusive & Ethical Design:** Integrate a gender perspective, eliminate algorithmic bias, improve physical/cognitive ergonomics, and uphold human values represented in `Digital Humanism` through strong integration of Social Sciences and Humanities (SSH).

🔗 **Strategic Alignment Mandates:** Proposals must connect with the `Apply AI Strategy`, build upon past projects in `Extended Reality Technologies (XR)` (e.g., `HORIZON-CL4-2021-HUMAN-01-13` / `14` / `25` / `06` / `28`), and implement the co-programmed European Partnerships `Made in Europe` and `AI, Data and Robotics`.
:::

## 🛣️ Strategic Alignment

This Research and Innovation Action (RIA) focuses on foundational and applied breakthroughs (starting at **TRL 4-5**) to achieve operational validation in manufacturing environments (achieving **TRL 6**). 

The socio-technical mandate directly addresses the twin transition by integrating human-centric AI design inside shifting global supply lines, preventing systemic knowledge loss during generational workforce transitions.

::: {.callout-tip icon=true}
### SCVCS' Technical Value Proposition
We provide the underlying governance, RegTech capabilities, and architectural frameworks necessary to anchor an **AI Environmental/Reputation Governance Harness**. 

This software platform layer (bridging **RegTech** and **FinTech**) provides the compliance instrumentation to audit human-machine systems, tracking ergonomic safety data, socio-technical value distribution, and cross-border regulatory alignments without creating data fragmentation.
:::

---

## 🤝 SCVCS' Core Areas of Collaboration

We are utilizing our research frameworks to establish structural bridges with partners targeting the following call mandates:

1. 🔏 **Knowledge Capture & Data Sovereignty:** Creating structured data repositories to capture expert operational knowledge. We apply the [International Data Spaces](https://internationaldataspaces.org/) architecture alongside the [IEEE International Roadmap for Devices and Systems (IRDS) Environment, Safety, Health, and Sustainability (ESHS) roadmaps](https://irds.ieee.org/images/files/pdf/2024/2024IRDS_ESHS-ESSF.pdf) to ensure factory-floor training data respects worker privacy and localized data protection mandates.

2. 🌊 **Socio-Economic Well-being Metrics:** Formulating frameworks to systematically monitor the "human well-being", inclusivity, and skill-acquisition metrics demanded by the call, translating shop-floor ergonomics into broader ESG reporting markers within modern value chains.

3. 🏫 **Cross-Cultural Living Lab Deployments:** Bridging European manufacturing technology with international settings by analyzing how machine interfaces adapt to workforce networks across different regions, ensuring industrial scaling translates to local structural resilience.

::: {.callout-note icon=true}
### 👷 Consortium Engagement

We are actively seeking to connect with:

- 🇪🇺 **EU-Based Consortium Leads:** Project coordinators looking to integrate explicit socio-technical frameworks, `Digital Humanism` principles, or RegTech auditing mechanisms into their advanced manufacturing proposals.
- 🏭 **Industrial & Technology Partners:** Automation vendors, XR developers, and manufacturing facilities eager to deploy co-learning AI pilots across diverse operational environments.
:::
